title: Enjoyable driving, ride, and design
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe enjoyment of the car's driving feel, ride comfort, quietness, luxury, and appearance, with a small undetermined set mentioning improvement requests without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight enjoying the way the car drives and rides, along with its quiet cabin, luxury feel, and sleek appearance.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention improvements or a desire to enjoy the car more, but the examples are too limited to identify a clear concrete sentiment pattern.

limitations: The sample fragments are heavily concentrated on broad statements of enjoyment, so specific liked features are only partially evidenced.
The undetermined examples are sparse and do not provide enough detail to characterize improvement themes beyond brief mentions.
One positive example expresses a desire to enjoy the car more, which makes its specific praised aspect unclear in the excerpt alone.
